title: Balanced Learning for Domain Adaptive Semantic Segmentation (BLDA)
mechanism: Detects over- and under-predicted classes from logit distributions and aligns them to shared anchor distributions, post hoc and inside self-training.
evidence: Consistent gains on two UDA benchmarks, mostly on under-predicted classes, when added to existing methods (abstract).
adaptation: Estimate per-class logit corrections from unlabelled E1-like pool cells (half-cells); E1 cracks are under-predicted (70% p<0.001). Use post hoc first, then inside the MIC arm.
min_experiment: Post-hoc BLDA correction on PF ensemble vs val-chosen crack logit bias; metric E1 crack relF1@2 and test crack IoU. Kill: < +0.02 E1 relF1@2.
prior_overlap: Partial: a single val-chosen crack logit bias was tried; per-class target-estimated alignment was not.
